_comment: The crew ledger. Loaded by the Rails service as seed data and shipped in the
app so the milestone track renders offline. Amounts are whole dollars.
This file is data, not code, on purpose: if the population turns out smaller
or larger than planned, the ladder is re-tuned with a migration and a content
update, not an App Store review cycle. Only `unlocks` entries need matching
client support, and every one of them is permanent and retroactive — a player
who installs after a milestone passed still gets it.

milestones.name: First Ledger Page
milestones.beat: The Collector initials the first page. He does not look up.

milestones.name: The Vault Cracks
milestones.beat: Someone leaves the vault inventory on the desk. Nobody admits it.

milestones.name: Lights Out
milestones.beat: Permits for after dark. Unsigned, but permits.

milestones.name: Union Rates
milestones.beat: Proper kit starts appearing in the supply tent. Nobody ordered it.

milestones.name: Field Notes
milestones.beat: The Collector's own annotations, in the margins of your collection.

milestones.name: Bone Dust Trail
milestones.beat: Your brush leaves a mark the crew recognises.

milestones.name: The Deep Quarry
milestones.beat: A lagoon that has not been opened in a hundred and fifty million years.

milestones.name: Salvage Rights
milestones.beat: The crew wins an argument. Every run now starts with fifty dollars in it.

milestones.name: The Collector Blinks
milestones.beat: The interest rate moves. Downward. For the first time.

milestones.name: Provenance
milestones.beat: Your specimens leave with a crew seal on the label. They are worth more for it.

milestones.name: Last Invoice
milestones.beat: He opens his own quarry to you. It is not generosity.

milestones.name: Paid In Full
milestones.beat: The ledger closes. Then his heir opens a new one.

_outfitComment: An outfit is a handful of diggers who pool what they pay. 'Crew' already means
every player alive against one debt, so a smaller group needed its own word --
'outfit' is what a survey party was called and leaves 'crew' unambiguous.
Outfit perks are kept small on purpose. They should make being in one feel good
without making solo play feel punished, because a player with no friends who dig
is still most of the audience.

outfitMilestones.name: Claim staked
outfitMilestones.beat: Somebody hammers a post in with your outfit's name on it.

outfitMilestones.name: A known outfit
outfitMilestones.beat: Other diggers start asking who you dig with.

outfitMilestones.name: Lamps for everyone
outfitMilestones.beat: Nobody in your outfit digs in the dark again.

outfitMilestones.name: On the honour roll
outfitMilestones.beat: Your outfit's name goes on the ledger itself.
